title: Summer Beach Strap Long Dress Loose And Flowing Casual Strap Long Dress Vacation Style Dress
body_html: This summer beach dress is made of light and breathable fabric, soft and comfortable, and has good drape. Loose-fitting design can hide the feeling of meat, refine the body shape, and is suitable for most body types. The thin belt design keeps cool in hot summer, and the flowing long dress brings an elegant feeling. It is very suitable for beach vacation, seaside travel, casual daily wear and holiday travel. Fashionable and multifunctional, it is a must-have dress in the summer wardrobe.
